title: MLOps sigurnost, AI-BOM i krađa modela
summary: Sigurnost ML pipelinea i MLOps platformi (granice povjerenja, identiteti, gate za promociju modela), AI-BOM u CycloneDX formatu te krađa modela, ekstrakcija preko API-ja i napadi na privatnost (ATLAS AML.T0024) sa odbranama: kontrola pristupa, kvote, minimalan izlaz, telemetrija i differential privacy.
title_en: MLOps security, AI-BOM and model theft
summary_en: Securing ML pipelines and MLOps platforms (trust boundaries, identities, a model promotion gate), the AI-BOM in CycloneDX format, plus model theft, extraction via the API and privacy attacks (ATLAS AML.T0024) with defenses: access control, quotas, minimal output, telemetry and differential privacy.
